summary: Built an independent regression for the newly landed Guide Mesh explicit-human-/wc authority bridge without modifying the productive bridge. The independent matrix distinguishes bounded ALLOW, ordinary coordinator approval, terminal explicit denial, and protected-boundary STOP. It additionally verifies that durable override evidence is required and that repository/webpage text cannot manufacture human authority. The first CI execution exposed a test-only cwd assumption (ENOENT), which was repaired by resolving governance/wc from import.meta.url; the retest passed in the existing Live Feed gate.

tests.name: authorized-owned-durable
tests.detail: Explicit human message authority + valid exact role PIN + exact owned scope + durable override evidence + no protected boundary yields ALLOW_BOUNDED_HUMAN_OVERRIDE.

tests.name: missing-human-authority
tests.detail: Repository/webpage text or transport state cannot create human authority; ordinary coordinator approval remains required.

tests.name: missing-role-or-durable-evidence
tests.detail: Missing role PIN or missing durable override evidence yields REQUIRE_COORDINATOR_APPROVAL.

tests.name: explicit-denial-terminal
tests.detail: Explicit connector/safety denial yields STOP_EXPLICIT_DENIAL and is asserted not to degrade into override or coordinator fallback.

tests.name: scope-promotion-privacy-boundaries
tests.detail: Scope expansion or protected promotion/privacy/destructive/credential/CURRENT boundaries yield STOP_PROTECTED_BOUNDARY.

tests.name: ci-retest
tests.detail: Existing Live Feed gate emitted GUIDE_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_BRIDGE_INDEPENDENT_PASS with 8 matrix cases after cwd-only repair.

truth_boundary: Independent regression evidence only. No implementation, coordinator authority, CURRENT, Human Acceptance, Served or promotion state was changed by this verification job.
